stories.title: Blustery and gray Black Friday, weekend weather looks great!
stories.summary: Wind gusts of 25 to 35 mph are possible throughout the day on Black Friday. More coastal flooding is likely.

stories.title: Are people still going to out to shop on Black Friday?
stories.summary: WJZ-TV's Stephanie Douglas went to the Annapolis Mall early Friday morning to find out.

stories.title: Scattered rain in Maryland Friday, weekend looks great
stories.summary: WJZ-TV meteorologist Steve Sosna has your latest weather forecast.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed until Saturday due to weather for first time in its 100-year history
stories.summary: For the first time in history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed due to weather, Macy's said Wednesday.

stories.title: Thanksgiving Nor'easter gradually moving out of Maryland
stories.summary: Cutter Martin has your Thursday evening forecast | 11/26/2026

stories.title: Cargo ship lost steering as it approached Maryland's Bay Bridge last week, pilot requested bridge closure
stories.summary: A cargo ship lost its steering ability last week while approaching the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, and the pilot notified Maryland transportation officials and requested a bridge closure, according to the Maryland Transportation Authority (MDTA).

stories.title: As Essence Festival leaves New Orleans, officials hold "extensive" talks to bring it to Baltimore
stories.summary: The Essence Festival of Culture is leaving New Orleans after more than 30 years, and officials in Maryland say they are holding "extensive discussions" to bring the festival to Baltimore.

stories.title: Lawyer for some Archdiocese of Baltimore abuse survivors talks about what's next in bankruptcy case
stories.summary: The clock is ticking for the Archdiocese of Baltimore and related entities of the church to settle abuse claims.

stories.title: Goodwill's annual Thanksgiving dinner connects Baltimore residents with community resources
stories.summary: Goodwill's 69th annual Thanksgiving dinner and resource fair in Baltimore served as a place for the community to come together and get any help that they may need.

stories.title: Thanksgiving nor'easter brings Maryland damaging winds, heavy rain and high tides
stories.summary: A Thanksgiving nor'easter storm brought Maryland damaging winds, heavy rain and high tides.

stories.title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms are impacting holiday festivities, disrupting travel plans
stories.summary: Rain, snow and powerful winds were affecting large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.
